_comment: Project component registry. Drop this in your per-job folder as figma.manifest.json. Claude loads it and passes it to buildSpec (or calls setManifest once per session). Only add a component ONCE IT'S STABLE — mapping a component you're still redesigning means re-mapping it every iteration.
_howToFill: nodeId is enough for local/unpublished components in the current file (get them from figma_search_components or figma_get_local_components). key is for components published to a team library and survives across files — prefer key when you have it, and include both when possible.

tokens._comment: Optional: the token prefixes in play, so Claude uses real names instead of inventing them. buildSpec resolves any variable by its full Figma name.
